report:
Ampulla of Vater, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)

Received in formalin is a pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection) specimen measuring 150 x 90 x 60 mm. The pancreatic head measures 55 x 45 x 35 mm, the attached duodenum measures 150 mm in length and the common bile duct measures 40 mm in length. The pancreatic neck, bile duct, uncinate (superior mesenteric artery) and posterior surfaces are inked in different colours and the neck and bile duct margins are taken en face. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the ampulla of Vater measuring 9 x 8 x 4 mm. The common bile duct is dilated to 16 mm and the pancreatic duct is dilated to 5 mm. The ampulla is bisected along the probed common bile duct and pancreatic duct and embedded in full. The lymph node stations are dissected separately and submitted in labelled cassettes. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-5) Ampulla, bisected along the probed ducts.
(6) Pancreatic neck margin, en face.
(7) Bile duct margin, en face.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)
- Origin: Ampullary (centred on the ampulla of Vater, including intra-ampullary
  and periampullary-duodenal)
- Tumour site: Intra-ampullary
- Tumour size: 0.9 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma, intestinal-type
- Histologic grade: G1, well differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a well differentiated adenocarcinoma, intestinal-type, limited to the ampulla of Vater and sphincter of Oddi. Cribriform and tubular glands are lined by tall columnar cells with elongated pseudostratified nuclei and contain luminal necrotic debris, resembling colorectal-type adenocarcinoma. The tumour cells express CK20, CDX2 and MUC2 and are negative for CK7.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Limited to the ampulla of Vater or
  sphincter of Oddi
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Precursor lesion: Ampullary adenoma (tubular, tubulovillous or villous)

Margins
- Pancreatic neck (transection) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 15 mm
- Bile duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 20 mm
- Uncinate (retroperitoneal / superior mesenteric artery) margin: Uninvolved by
  invasive carcinoma, 6 mm
- Posterior surface: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 5 mm
- Proximal (gastric or duodenal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 50 mm
- Distal (duodenal or jejunal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 55 mm
- Pancreatic duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 14 mm
- Duodenal mucosal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 48 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 16 examined; 0 involved
  - Number examined: 16
  - Number involved: 0

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1a pN0
  - Stage group (if cM0): IA

Additional findings
